(Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge)}} |early release= |release date=[[February 25]], [[2025]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type= |pages=24 |isbn=9780736445269 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Batuu]] to [[34 ABY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Galaxy's Edge: A Batuu Adventure!''''' is a children's book by [[Jeneanne DeBois]] published by [[Golden Books]] that was released on [[February 25]], [[2025]]. ==Publisher's summary== '''Explore a galaxy far, far away in this Little Golden Book based on the Disney Parks' Galaxy's Edge Star Wars attraction!''' When a young, curious boy and his family stop on Batuu to refuel their ship, he quickly gets swept into a rebel adventure! Follow his journey as he explores the streets of Black Spire Outpost in this Little Golden Book that features locations, characters, and creatures from the Disney Parks' Star Wars-themed Galaxy's Edge attraction. This exciting book is perfect for kids 5 and up and Star Wars fans and collectors of all ages. ==Plot summary== {{Plot}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: A
